title: You've never snoozed a fire alarm
summary: Low-poly story: nobody snoozes a fire alarm, but he snoozes his 6 AM alarm seven times and is late again. So he makes his alarm work like a fire alarm with Unsnooze: push-ups, 100 steps, math, memory, shaking the phone. He hasn't been late since.
